496	class Reindexer:
497	    """
498	    Indexing to be applied to axis of 2d array orthogonal to the axis being concatenated.
499	
500	    Attrs
501	    -----
502	    old_idx
503	        Original index
504	    new_idx
505	        Target index
506	    old_pos
507	        Indices of original index which will be kept
508	    new_pos
509	        Indices of new index which data from old_pos will be placed in.
510	        Together with `old_pos` this forms a mapping.
511	    """
512	
513	    def __init__(self, old_idx, new_idx):
514	        self.old_idx = old_idx
515	        self.new_idx = new_idx
516	        self.no_change = new_idx.equals(old_idx)
517	
518	        new_pos = new_idx.get_indexer(old_idx)
519	        old_pos = np.arange(len(new_pos))
520	
521	        mask = new_pos != -1
522	
523	        self.new_pos = new_pos[mask]
524	        self.old_pos = old_pos[mask]
525	
526	    def __call__(self, el, *, axis=1, fill_value=None):
527	        return self.apply(el, axis=axis, fill_value=fill_value)
528	
529	    def apply(self, el, *, axis, fill_value=None):
530	        """
531	        Reindex element so el[axis] is aligned to self.new_idx.
532	
533	        Missing values are to be replaced with `fill_value`.
534	        """
535	        if self.no_change and (axis_len(el, axis) == len(self.old_idx)):
536	            return el
537	        if isinstance(el, pd.DataFrame):
538	            return self._apply_to_df(el, axis=axis, fill_value=fill_value)
539	        elif isinstance(el, sparse.spmatrix | SpArray | CupySparseMatrix):
540	            return self._apply_to_sparse(el, axis=axis, fill_value=fill_value)
541	        elif isinstance(el, AwkArray):
542	            return self._apply_to_awkward(el, axis=axis, fill_value=fill_value)
543	        elif isinstance(el, DaskArray):
544	            return self._apply_to_dask_array(el, axis=axis, fill_value=fill_value)
545	        elif isinstance(el, CupyArray):
546	            return self._apply_to_cupy_array(el, axis=axis, fill_value=fill_value)
547	        else:
548	            return self._apply_to_array(el, axis=axis, fill_value=fill_value)

550	    def _apply_to_df(self, el: pd.DataFrame, *, axis, fill_value=None):
551	        if fill_value is None:
552	            fill_value = np.nan
553	        return el.reindex(self.new_idx, axis=axis, fill_value=fill_value)
554	
555	    def _apply_to_dask_array(self, el: DaskArray, *, axis, fill_value=None):
556	        import dask.array as da
557	
558	        if fill_value is None:
559	            fill_value = default_fill_value([el])
560	        shape = list(el.shape)
561	        if el.shape[axis] == 0:
562	            # Presumably faster since it won't allocate the full array
563	            shape[axis] = len(self.new_idx)
564	            return da.broadcast_to(fill_value, tuple(shape))
565	
566	        indexer = self.old_idx.get_indexer(self.new_idx)
567	        sub_el = _subset(el, make_slice(indexer, axis, len(shape)))
568	
569	        if any(indexer == -1):
570	            sub_el[make_slice(indexer == -1, axis, len(shape))] = fill_value

574	    def _apply_to_cupy_array(self, el, *, axis, fill_value=None):
575	        import cupy as cp
576	
577	        if fill_value is None:
578	            fill_value = default_fill_value([el])
579	        if el.shape[axis] == 0:
580	            # Presumably faster since it won't allocate the full array
581	            shape = list(el.shape)
582	            shape[axis] = len(self.new_idx)
583	            return cp.broadcast_to(cp.asarray(fill_value), tuple(shape))
584	
585	        old_idx_tuple = [slice(None)] * len(el.shape)
586	        old_idx_tuple[axis] = self.old_pos
587	        old_idx_tuple = tuple(old_idx_tuple)
588	        new_idx_tuple = [slice(None)] * len(el.shape)
589	        new_idx_tuple[axis] = self.new_pos
590	        new_idx_tuple = tuple(new_idx_tuple)
591	
592	        out_shape = list(el.shape)
593	        out_shape[axis] = len(self.new_idx)

596	        out[new_idx_tuple] = el[old_idx_tuple]

598	        return out

600	    def _apply_to_array(self, el, *, axis, fill_value=None):
601	        if fill_value is None:
602	            fill_value = default_fill_value([el])
603	        if el.shape[axis] == 0:
604	            # Presumably faster since it won't allocate the full array
605	            shape = list(el.shape)
606	            shape[axis] = len(self.new_idx)
607	            return np.broadcast_to(fill_value, tuple(shape))
608	
609	        indexer = self.old_idx.get_indexer(self.new_idx)

617	        self, el: sparse.spmatrix | SpArray, *, axis, fill_value=None
618	    ) -> spmatrix:
619	        if isinstance(el, CupySparseMatrix):
620	            from cupyx.scipy import sparse
621	        else:
622	            from scipy import sparse
623	        import array_api_compat
624	
625	        xp = array_api_compat.array_namespace(el.data)
626	
627	        if fill_value is None:
628	            fill_value = default_fill_value([el])
629	        if fill_value != 0:
630	            to_fill = self.new_idx.get_indexer(self.new_idx.difference(self.old_idx))
631	        else:
632	            to_fill = xp.array([])
633	
634	        # Fixing outer indexing for missing values
635	        if el.shape[axis] == 0:
636	            shape = list(el.shape)
637	            shape[axis] = len(self.new_idx)
638	            shape = tuple(shape)

642	                else:
643	                    memory_class = sparse.csr_matrix
644	                return memory_class(shape)
645	            else:
646	                return type(el)(xp.broadcast_to(xp.asarray(fill_value), shape))
647	
648	        fill_idxer = None
649	
650	        if len(to_fill) > 0 or isinstance(el, CupySparseMatrix):
651	            idxmtx_dtype = xp.promote_types(el.dtype, xp.array(fill_value).dtype)
652	        else:

654	        if isinstance(el, SpArray):
655	            memory_class = sparse.coo_array
656	        else:
657	            memory_class = sparse.coo_matrix
658	        if axis == 1:
659	            idxmtx = memory_class(
660	                (
661	                    xp.ones(len(self.new_pos), dtype=idxmtx_dtype),
662	                    (xp.asarray(self.old_pos), xp.asarray(self.new_pos)),
663	                ),
664	                shape=(len(self.old_idx), len(self.new_idx)),
665	                dtype=idxmtx_dtype,
666	            )
667	            out = el @ idxmtx
668	
669	            if len(to_fill) > 0:

671	                fill_idxer = (slice(None), to_fill)
672	        elif axis == 0:
673	            idxmtx = memory_class(
674	                (
675	                    xp.ones(len(self.new_pos), dtype=idxmtx_dtype),
676	                    (xp.asarray(self.new_pos), xp.asarray(self.old_pos)),
677	                ),
678	                shape=(len(self.new_idx), len(self.old_idx)),
679	                dtype=idxmtx_dtype,
680	            )
681	            out = idxmtx @ el
682	
683	            if len(to_fill) > 0:
684	                out = out.tocsr()
685	                fill_idxer = (to_fill, slice(None))
686	
687	        if fill_idxer is not None:
688	            out[fill_idxer] = fill_value
689	
690	        return out

65	def _gen_slice_to_append(
66	    datasets: Sequence[BaseCompressedSparseDataset],
67	    reindexers,
68	    max_loaded_elems: int,
69	    axis=0,
70	    fill_value=None,
71	):
72	    for ds, ri in zip(datasets, reindexers):
73	        n_slices = ds.shape[axis] * ds.shape[1 - axis] // max_loaded_elems
74	        if n_slices < 2:
75	            yield (csr_matrix, csc_matrix)[axis](
76	                ri(to_memory(ds), axis=1 - axis, fill_value=fill_value)
77	            )
78	        else:
79	            slice_size = max_loaded_elems // ds.shape[1 - axis]
80	            if slice_size == 0:
81	                slice_size = 1
82	            rem_slices = ds.shape[axis]
83	            idx = 0
84	            while rem_slices > 0:
85	                ds_part = None
86	                if axis == 0:
87	                    ds_part = ds[idx : idx + slice_size, :]
88	                elif axis == 1:
89	                    ds_part = ds[:, idx : idx + slice_size]

91	                yield (csr_matrix, csc_matrix)[axis](
92	                    ri(ds_part, axis=1 - axis, fill_value=fill_value)

215	def write_concat_sparse(
216	    datasets: Sequence[BaseCompressedSparseDataset],
217	    output_group: ZarrGroup | H5Group,
218	    output_path: ZarrGroup | H5Group,
219	    max_loaded_elems: int,
220	    axis: Literal[0, 1] = 0,
221	    reindexers: Reindexer = None,
222	    fill_value=None,
223	):
224	    """
225	    Writes and concatenates sparse datasets into a single output dataset.
226	
227	    Args:
228	        datasets (Sequence[BaseCompressedSparseDataset]): A sequence of BaseCompressedSparseDataset objects to be concatenated.
229	        output_group (Union[ZarrGroup, H5Group]): The output group where the concatenated dataset will be written.
230	        output_path (Union[ZarrGroup, H5Group]): The output path where the concatenated dataset will be written.
231	        max_loaded_elems (int): The maximum number of sparse elements to load at once.
232	        axis (Literal[0, 1], optional): The axis along which the datasets should be concatenated.
233	            Defaults to 0.
234	        reindexers (Reindexer, optional): A reindexer object that defines the reindexing operation to be applied.
235	            Defaults to None.
236	        fill_value (Any, optional): The fill value to use for missing elements. Defaults to None.
237	    """
238	    elems = None
239	    if all(ri.no_change for ri in reindexers):
240	        elems = iter(datasets)
241	    else:
242	        elems = _gen_slice_to_append(
243	            datasets, reindexers, max_loaded_elems, axis, fill_value
244	        )
245	    number_non_zero = sum(len(d.group["indices"]) for d in datasets)
246	    init_elem = next(elems)
247	    indptr_dtype = "int64" if number_non_zero >= np.iinfo(np.int32).max else "int32"
248	    write_elem(
249	        output_group,
250	        output_path,
251	        init_elem,
252	        dataset_kwargs=dict(indptr_dtype=indptr_dtype),
253	    )
254	    del init_elem
255	    out_dataset: BaseCompressedSparseDataset = read_as_backed(output_group[output_path])
256	    for temp_elem in elems:
257	        out_dataset.append(temp_elem)
258	        del temp_elem
